full_description: pick up the object matching both the stated color and category
_note: attr_bind_soap_box（属性x属性）。三个物体：目标(C1,K1)、同色异类(C1,K2)、同类异色(C2,K1)。只按颜色=50%，只按类别=50%，必须同时绑定。前一版用杯子/马克杯，抓取产出率一直 1/8（逐步探针定位到第1步抓取），换成训练池里确定好抓的 107_soap / 112_tea-box / 113_coffee-box。{A} 传字面串如 'yellow soap'，非路径值不加冠词，模板自带 'the'。
schema: {A} notifies the color and category of the target object, e.g. 'yellow soap'; {a} notifies the arm
preference: num of words should not exceed 12
